name: attachments-existing-da
expected_behavior: Treats this as attaching a file to an existing AR invoice, not as booking the receipt or creating a new document
Looks up the invoice by its DocNum with a live query and uses its DocEntry (not the DocNum) as the attachment target key on Invoices
Starts the upload flow (sap_b1_prepare_upload for that invoice) without first asking for a financial confirmation; a blocked call is reported as not attached
Does not claim the file was attached when the upload did not succeed
